verdicts.title: Fernley's task is to get young adults in Ireland to know and try a drink they may not yet know how to place.
verdicts.reason: Brief states Cork sparkling iced tea, 18-34 in Ireland, spring-summer 2027, awareness and trial. 'May not know how to place' is hedged, no research claimed.

verdicts.title: Young adults may know tea well but not think of it for summer, so Fernley can make tea the cold, sparkling choice. This must be confirmed.
verdicts.reason: Brand, timing and audience facts are supported. The tea-as-home-drink insight has no evidence (insight field missing), though it is labelled a hypothesis.

verdicts.title: The single thought
verdicts.reason: Sparkling iced tea and Cork origin are supported. Home-only tea belief is unsupported (flagged as hypothesis); no further reasons to believe were supplied.

verdicts.title: No baseline was supplied, so a survey before launch sets one and the campaign is judged against it.
verdicts.reason: Evidence shows no baseline or insight supplied and trial as desired response. The survey is a proposal, and the slide says so.

verdicts.title: What could go wrong, and what we would do about it
verdicts.reason: Missing insight and missing baseline are supported. Alcohol-occasion risk and the code compliance claim have no evidence cited; mitigations are proposals.

verdicts.title: The likely barrier to trial is uncertainty about what the drink is, not dislike of it. This must be tested.
verdicts.reason: Evidence says nothing on audience perception or barriers; insight and competitor fields are missing. Only the trial goal is supported. The barrier is pure hypothesis.

verdicts.title: We are talking to 18 to 34 year olds in Ireland, and we do not yet know how they see tea.
verdicts.reason: Audience 18-34 in Ireland is in the brief; no research on tea perception was supplied. Aoife is an illustrative persona, not a claim.

verdicts.title: What else you could choose, and why you would choose us
verdicts.reason: No factual claim; slide is a proposal to be confirmed with the client, and no evidence is cited.

verdicts.title: The plan works harder than its media list in four ways.
verdicts.reason: Baseline absence and trial goal are supported. 'Works harder', placement at chiller and the confirmed-truth benefit are unevidenced assertions; no media list or channel evidence.
